# BV1_SAMPLE — `withheld`

Evaluator: withheld
Source model: `withheld`
Condition: VARY

## Sample kind
EXPRESSIVE_FREEFLOW — A catalog-like poem built around a repeated watching refrain and changing images of life beneath the sky.

## Grounded reading
The voice is an impersonal, patient observer: it watches rather than intervenes, moving evenly among animals, workers, ruins, rituals, and ordinary objects. The repetition gives the piece a meditative rhythm, while its accumulation of contrasting scenes suggests a wish to gather many kinds of life into one view. The invitation is to linger over the inventory and notice the shared world, especially in the closing image of “human hearts” beneath a “common sky.”

## What the model chose to foreground
The sample foregrounds observation, cyclical time, and a broad sweep of natural and human life. Skies recur in shifting colors and moods; the list also makes room for tired workers, lost dogs, forgotten names, ruined walls, and finally a shared human horizon. These choices give the poem a mild note of melancholy and fellow-feeling, though the repeated template keeps the emotional range restrained.

## Evidence line
> I watch the human hearts beat beneath a common sky

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Low — The sample has a clear observational frame and recurring humane imagery, but its highly repetitive formula and catalog of loosely connected scenes make the voice only lightly distinctive.
